total_pass_rule: All 11 bars must be PASS before any OA module or the tooling can be called complete.

bars.label: PRD→代码完整覆盖
bars.criterion: Every PRD-stated requirement and logically necessary counterpart survives from design through code and tests.

bars.label: 功能完整度
bars.criterion: The generated implementation covers the full in-scope functional surface, not only a happy-path slice.

bars.label: 无漏洞
bars.criterion: Generation plus folded multi-dimensional detection reaches the accepted no-crit/high and correctness-clean threshold.

bars.label: 测试全业务覆盖
bars.criterion: Tests cover new business behavior and regression coverage for changed existing behavior.

bars.label: PRD 缺陷有替代实现
bars.criterion: PRD gaps or contradictions are handled by explicit inferred or deferred implementation decisions, not silent guesses.

bars.label: 识别 PRD 不合理
bars.criterion: The chain identifies unreasonable or contradictory PRD content and routes it to decision evidence instead of blindly coding it.

bars.label: 跨模块冲突识别+方案
bars.criterion: Cross-module conflicts and dependencies are identified, false positives are excluded, and unresolved conflicts have a proposed resolution path.

bars.label: 迭代次数最低
bars.criterion: The first-pass generation and subsequent corrections converge with minimal logical rework.

bars.label: 质量审查全面
bars.criterion: Quality review catches real defects across relevant dimensions and produces an honest gate result.

bars.label: 架构优化
bars.criterion: The chain proposes architecture improvements that survive ground verification, not PRD-only guesses about already-solved problems.

bars.label: 代码量减少更好实现
bars.criterion: At project scale and equal functionality, the implementation reduces duplication or code volume while preserving a better design.
